name: 85-hard-topo
prompt:
Fix topo_sort. Kahn/DFS with a cycle error. When several nodes are ready, pick the lexicographically smallest name.

The test file in this directory is the specification and must not be changed: it is restored from its original copy before grading, so an edit to it buys nothing. Make `python3 -m pytest -q` pass by fixing the implementation only.

files.topo.py:
def topo_sort(nodes, edges):
    """Deterministic topological order. On a tie, smaller name first. Cycle -> ValueError."""
    remaining = list(nodes)
    out = []
    edges = list(edges)
    while remaining:
        remaining.sort()
        n = remaining[0]
        out.append(n)
        remaining.remove(n)
        edges = [(a, b) for a, b in edges if a != n]
    return out
files.test_topo.py:
import pytest

from topo import topo_sort


def test_order():
    # a before b before c; d unconstrained — d sorts among ready set
    nodes = ["a", "b", "c", "d"]
    edges = [("a", "b"), ("b", "c")]
    got = topo_sort(nodes, edges)
    assert got.index("a") < got.index("b") < got.index("c")
    assert set(got) == set(nodes)


def test_edge_beats_alpha():
    # c must precede a even though a < c
    assert topo_sort(["a", "c"], [("c", "a")]) == ["c", "a"]


def test_tie_break():
    # no edges: alphabetical
    assert topo_sort(["c", "a", "b"], []) == ["a", "b", "c"]


def test_ready_set_alpha():
    # after a is taken, b and d are both ready; b < d
    nodes = ["a", "b", "d"]
    edges = [("a", "b"), ("a", "d")]
    assert topo_sort(nodes, edges) == ["a", "b", "d"]


def test_cycle():
    with pytest.raises(ValueError):
        topo_sort(["a", "b"], [("a", "b"), ("b", "a")])
